import sys, math, os, io
sys.path.insert\(0, '.'\)
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side

R = 8.314

def thin_border\(\):
    s = Side\(style='thin'\)
    return Border\(left=s, right=s, top=s, bottom=s\)

def hfill\(\):
    return PatternFill\('solid', fgColor='4472C4'\)

def write_data_sheet\(ws, headers, rows, col_widths=None\):
    for ci, h in enumerate\(headers, 1\):
        c = ws.cell\(1, ci, h\)
        c.font = Font\(bold=True, color='FFFFFF'\)
        c.fill = hfill\(\)
        c.alignment = Alignment\(horizontal='center', wrap_text=True\)
        c.border = thin_border\(\)
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 32
    for ri, row in enumerate\(rows, 2\):
        for ci, val in enumerate\(row, 1\):
            ws.cell\(ri, ci, val if val is not None else ''\).border = thin_border\(\)
    if col_widths:
        for ci, w in enumerate\(col_widths, 1\):
            ws.column_dimensions[chr\(64+ci\)].width = w

def add_meta_sheet\(wb, name, substance, c0, temp, note\):
    ws = wb.create_sheet\(chr\(23455\)+chr\(39443\)+chr\(26465\)+chr\(20214\)\)
    rows = [
        \(chr\(12521\)+chr\(12505\)+chr\(12523\), chr\(20516\), chr\(21333\)+chr\(20301\)\),
        \(chr\(23455\)+chr\(39443\)+chr\(21517\), name, ''\),
        \(chr\(21453\)+chr\(24540\)+chr\(29289\)+chr\(36074\), substance, ''\),
        \(chr\(21021\)+chr\(26399\)+chr\(28065\)+chr\(24230\), c0, 'mol/L'\),
        \(chr\(21453\)+chr\(24540\)+chr\(28201\)+chr\(24230\), temp, chr\(176\)+'C'\),
        \(chr\(23455\)+chr\(39443\)+chr\(26085\), '2026-03-09', 'date'\),
        \(chr\(25285\)+chr\(24403\)+chr\(32773\), 'test', ''\),
        \(chr\(20633\)+chr\(32989\), note, ''\),
    ]
    for ri, \(l, v, u\) in enumerate\(rows, 1\):
        for ci, val in enumerate\([l, v, u], 1\):
            c = ws.cell\(ri, ci, val\)
            c.border = thin_border\(\)
            if ri == 1:
                c.font = Font\(bold=True, color='FFFFFF'\)
                c.fill = hfill\(\)
                c.alignment = Alignment\(horizontal='center'\)
    ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 14
    ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 22
    ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 10

HDRS_A = [
    chr\(26178\)+chr\(38291\)+' \(Time\)\\n\(min\)',
    chr\(28065\)+chr\(24230\)+'_A \(Concentration_A\)\\n\(mol/L\)',
    chr\(28201\)+chr\(24230\)+' \(Temperature\)\\n\('+chr\(176\)+'C\)',
    chr\(20633\)+chr\(32989\)+' \(Notes\)\\n\(-\)'
]
WIDTHS_A = [18, 22, 18, 12]

os.makedirs\('sample_data', exist_ok=True\)

Ea, Af = 50000, 6e6
times4 = [0, 10, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120]

wb4 = openpyxl.Workbook\(\)
ws4 = wb4.active; ws4.title = chr\(23455\)+chr\(39443\)+chr\(12487\)+chr\(12540\)+chr\(12479\)
all_rows4 = []
for T_c in [25.0, 35.0, 45.0, 55.0]:
    T_K = T_c + 273.15
    kt = Af * math.exp\(-Ea / \(R * T_K\)\)
    note_list = [str\(T_c\)+'C start'] + [''] * 6 + [str\(T_c\)+'C end']
    for t, nt in zip\(times4, note_list\):
        all_rows4.append\(\(t, round\(math.exp\(-kt * t\), 6\), T_c, nt\)\)
write_data_sheet\(ws4, HDRS_A, all_rows4, WIDTHS_A\)
add_meta_sheet\(wb4, 'multi_temp_Arrhenius_Ea=50kJ', 'A', 1.0, '25-55C', 'Ea=50kJ/mol, A=6e6'\)
wb4.save\('sample_data/sample4_multi_temp_arrhenius.xlsx'\)
print\('OK'\)
")
